direction_as_read: mixed: pooled knee pain benefit with low certainty and high heterogeneity; imaging and biomarker outcomes mostly null; a named-primary trial splits between pain and effusion
summary: Of the 39 labels, 20 print 93 to 95% curcuminoids or standardized to curcuminoids, 13 an extract with no stated standard, 2 a 10:1 ratio alone and 1 a 4:1 ratio; Meriva, Curcumin C3 Complex and CurcuWIN (20%) each sit alone on one label, and 243134 prints CurcuWIN beside a 95% row. Two trials meet the rule with a verified dose: NR-INF-02 500 mg twice daily was better than placebo on named primaries (23242572), and CuraMed 500 mg three times daily beat placebo on physical tests but was not reported significant on WOMAC pain (29316908). Neither preparation is on these labels. Syntheses favor knee pain with low certainty (33511486, 40731001).
question_for_clinician: 23242572 and 29316908 meet the review rule for a Curcuma longa extract at or near some labels' amount, but neither names a preparation these labels print. Does any credit reach an unbranded 95% curcuminoid extract? Agent recommendation: no credit; curcuminoid content differs across preparations and 11 labels print an extract row of 150 mg or less.
